title: Selling Plans Fee Volume Relief on Term Change Fees
content:
A seller whose **Selling Plans** plan has billed substantial net seller fees in the last year receives a volume relief on the term change fee charged for moving a store from the annual to the monthly term.

**Rule.** The volume relief of a term change fee is the high volume relief when the plan's net seller fees over the last twelve whole months are at least the high net-fee threshold, the mid volume relief when they are at least the mid net-fee threshold but below the high net-fee threshold, and nothing below the mid net-fee threshold; net seller fees are the subscription, insertion, final value and early termination fees billed less the fee credits booked, each counted when its billing date is less than twelve whole months before the decision date.

A relief is taken from the repayment share of the term change fee: the reliefs that apply are added together first and the total is taken from one once.

## Relief schedule

| Net seller fees of the plan, last twelve whole months | Volume relief |
|---|---|
| USD 4000.00 or more (the high net-fee threshold) | 30% (high volume relief) |
| USD 1500.00 or more but below USD 4000.00 | 15% (mid volume relief) |
| Below USD 1500.00 | None |

## What the net seller fees include

| Fee record | Counted |
|---|---|
| Subscription fees billed | Added |
| Insertion fees billed | Added |
| Final value fees billed (every component) | Added |
| Early termination fees billed | Added |
| Fee credits booked, whatever their credit reason | Subtracted |

Each record counts when its billing date is less than twelve whole months before the decision date.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical totals)

- Fees billed USD 4100.00, credits USD 100.00: net USD 4000.00 → 30%.
- Fees billed USD 4100.00, credits USD 100.01: net USD 3999.99 → 15%.
- Net USD 1500.00 → 15%; net USD 1499.99 → no volume relief.
